propositions: Write-op input surfaces (force/reason/caused_by/ref/close_class) are hand-mirrored across three adapters but lack mechanical parity enforcement, allowing silent parameter drift.

A behavioral conformance oracle driven by a single shared contract table tests each write op (transition/claim/create) across all three adapters against fresh stores, detecting any divergence in ACCEPTED/REJECTED/PARAM_NOT_EXPOSED classification.

Runtime conditional rules (close_class required for bug-close, reason required for reason-required classes) must be asserted behaviorally on every adapter, not expressible through shape generation alone.

MCP gaps on transition (force/reason/caused_by/ref) and claim (force) are encoded as strict-xfail rows citing scratchy-leprous-galago, keeping the suite green until the sibling ticket's fixes cause those rows to xpass and require marker removal.
Adapter-bound internals (source/return_alias/_creation_channel/repo_root) are excluded from the contract surface to prevent false divergence signals.
